title: Validate book
summary: Local PDF/HTML structure and typography checks, shared CSS without inline declarations, default iframe/article parity, English-first presentation and text-only book-root reports. Preserves source page boundaries with separate cover/title pages and text-preserving page containers. Measures source page padding and restores contents leaders, indentation and page labels. Preserves display alignment and excludes repeated running headers from body-margin estimates. Preserves source paragraph borders through shared PDF drawing evidence. Detects and recovers flattened source lists with page-continuing numbering and source list typography. Body leading excludes other font sizes; the reader adapter supports generic local-book stylesheet imports and frame/root scale parity. Generic mixed-font centered/left title pages and source horizontal rules are reconstructed and checked in both reader delivery modes.
